events.body:
## Context

`public/dashboard.js` uses `via.placeholder.com` (shut down) for default avatars although `public/assets/images/sample-avatar.svg` exists. Blog titles are `<h3 onclick="window.open(...)">`, unreachable by keyboard, and `styles.css` has no focus styles.

## What to do

1. Use the local SVGs as defaults.
2. Render `<h3><a href target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">`.
3. Add `:focus-visible` outlines and `aria-hidden` on decorative icons.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No placeholder.com requests
- [ ] Blog titles reachable with Tab and open with Enter
- [ ] Visible focus ring

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d my-gsoc-tool/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
